newsitem.title: GREECE: SOCCER-OLYMPIAKOS SET FOR FIRST CHAMPIONSHIP IN 10 YEARS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-OLYMPIAKOS SET FOR FIRST CHAMPIONSHIP IN 10 YEARS.

text.p: Olympiakos, one of Greece's most popular soccer club, look set for their first championship in 10 years after a precious 2-0 away victory against champions and bitter rivals Panathinaikos.

With six rounds to go Olympiakos lead the first division standings with 68 points, six clear of AEK who are second. OFI are a distant third with 56 points and Panathinaikos fourth, a further two points behind.
Thousands of Olympiakos fans threw an all-night party after the end of the match on Sunday with champagne and beer in central Athens squares.
Olympiakos, who last won a Greek championship in 1987, feature a young team, put together by Serb coach Dusan Bayevic.

They have been highly successful after 28 rounds (21, wins, five draws, two defeats) despite playing most of the season without their two Serb star strikers Predrag Georgevic and Ilia Ivic, both out with injuries.
"There is still another six rounds but our psychology is that of a champion. Nothing can stop us now," a club official said.
